facebook.caption:
POV: you skip the resort beach and end up in Rạch Hàm instead.

Ham Ninh fishing town is the real Phu Quoc. Wooden boats. Crab traps drying in the sun. Locals who actually live here.

4.1 stars across 1,055 reviews and most tourists drive straight past it on TL47.

Go slow. Walk the pier. Eat whatever the woman with the coal pot is cooking.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
